Seris 0.1.1 improves long-running AI tasks and makes tool permissions configurable per conversation.

### Changes

- Remove the runtime limit on model turns and tool calls that caused **Run reached its step limit**. Long tasks can continue until they finish or the user presses **Stop**.
- Add **Ask every time** and **Allow all actions** below the chat input. The permission choice applies to the current conversation and survives restarts; new conversations default to asking.
- Switching to Allow all actions releases an action already waiting for approval. Switching back restores confirmation for subsequent gated actions, including saving strategies and using terminal or browser tools.
- Keep permission changes behind the authenticated UI API; model-generated prompt parameters cannot enable Allow all actions.
- Preserve model tool declarations when refreshing the permission instructions sent to the model, and keep composer controls usable in the narrower Markets chat layout.
- Add an English repository guide covering architecture, coding, commits, releases and validation. Prefer Computer Use for functional checks and add automated tests only when necessary.
- Update the existing packaged-upgrade check to support stable-to-stable upgrades, correct real candle timestamps and verify persisted chat permissions.

### Validation

- The implementation passed 88 existing and targeted regression checks, including 96 consecutive tool rounds, cancellation, permission persistence and rejection of unauthorized permission changes. No additional test files were added during release preparation.
- TypeScript checks and a compiled-client visual check passed during implementation.
- Computer Use verified the actual client from the candidate DMG: existing conversations and the saved model connection loaded, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash retrieved real Hyperliquid BTC hourly candles, produced a summary and opened the corresponding chart. The permission menu was also checked in the narrower Markets chat.
- Complete bundle signatures and packaged runtime resources passed verification. The runtime started without the checkout or a system Node installation.
- The published 0.1.0 bundle upgraded to the candidate 0.1.1 bundle using disposable data and their own Node runtimes. Conversations, model metadata, watchlists, strategy source and a backtest using 199 closed Binance candles survived the upgrade and removal of the old runtime. Legacy chats defaulted to asking; Allow all actions persisted across the candidate's restart.

### Installation and scope

- **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon).** Quit Seris, open the DMG and replace the app in Applications. Local conversations, model metadata, watchlists, strategies and backtests remain outside the app bundle.
- **Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.** After the first blocked launch, approve Seris in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. An upgrade may require keychain authorization for an existing model credential; if the credential store is unavailable, unlock it and restart Seris or re-save the model connection in Settings.
- Allow all actions permits available gated tools in that conversation to run without individual confirmation. It does not enable unsupported trading or wallet functions. You can return to Ask every time or stop an active task at any time.
- Strategies remain local historical backtests. Live orders, wallet transfers and connected portfolios are outside this release's scope; alerts run only while the app is running.
